title: 第4章 异变
content_zh:
乌山下，乌山部落内，此刻所有的族人几乎都在部落的中心，看着那群蛮启的拉苏。

但就在这时，突然那漂浮在半空的巨大蛮像，其身蓦然一震，似颤抖一样，更有轰鸣之声骤然而起了，那声音来的太过突然，让这四周的所有族人均都一愣。

阿公双目精光一闪，猛的上前几步，他没有去看那蛮像，而是立刻抬头看向天空，看着看着，他的眼中露出了凝重。

此刻，更多的族人也发现了异常，纷纷抬头看向天幕。

只见那天空上，有一道道黑气凭空出现，从四面八方疯狂的凝聚，很快就形成了一个巨大的漩涡，那漩涡之大，似占据了此地大半个天空，笼罩整个乌山八方，即便是距离很远，也可以看到此地的异变。

那漩涡形成后，缓缓地转动，发出了轰隆隆如雷鸣般的巨响，回荡四周。更是在那漩涡内，有无数弧形的电光游走，闪电扫过，与雷鸣交错。

“蛮祖显灵！？”乌山部落内的那些族人，不知是谁喊了出来，立刻纷纷跪拜在地，神色带着敬畏与恐惧，向着天空膜拜起来。

站立的人，唯有阿公与其身旁几个部落里的首领，除了阿公外，这些首领大汉也是神色露出惊慌。

那天空上的漩涡转动速度越来越快，片刻后，似有狂风横扫大地，使得这乌山附近八方被完全的笼罩在内。

那漂浮在半空的蛮像，此刻更是颤抖的剧烈，仿佛在那漩涡下，无法承受一样。

此时此刻，在那乌山的另一边，有一处与乌山部落大小类似的部落，此部落名为黑山，如今这黑山部落里，所有的族人纷纷骇然，在他们部落的半空，一个十丈大小的蛮像赫然漂浮。

那蛮像全身漆黑，完全不具备人形，看起来好似一只蜥蜴，此刻不断地颤抖，似要崩溃一样。在那蛮像下，有一个穿着黑色的粗麻长衫，枯瘦如骷髅般的老者，神色阴沉，不知在想些什么。

同样的一幕，在这乌山附近的所有部落内，全部同时出现，甚至更远一些地方的部落，也均都如此。

没有人知道，到底发生了什么，这漩涡又为何会出现，就连那乌山部落的阿公，也都忽略了方才走入蛮像体内参拜的苏铭。

乌山部落蛮像内，那幽光一闪之间，赫然将这四周的所有空间全部占据，将此地弥漫在了那诡异的光芒中，更是在苏铭的目瞪口呆下，他看到不远处那之前需要参拜的蛮像通体一震，好似从静止沉睡中复活了一般，竟让他有一种似此像具备了血肉的错觉。

他甚至能看到，那原本狰狞的蛮像，此刻在这幽光中，剧烈的颤抖起来，仿佛无法承受这光芒的笼罩。

这蛮像半人半兽，左手抓着巨龙，右手拿着长枪，可如今却是在那颤抖中，那股原始野蛮的气息赫然改变，露出了一丝让苏铭不知是否还是错觉的惊恐。

苏铭脑子里一片空白，他不知道发生了什么事情，不知道为什么会这样，他站在那里，怔住了。

他的全身同样被那颈脖碎片的幽光弥漫，似与此地空间融合在了一起，随着那幽光越来越明亮，仅仅是片刻的时间，这蛮像的世界里，已经完全成为了幽色。

苏铭只感觉脑子轰的一声，好似有什么壁障被一股无形的力量冲破，让他身子颤抖间，脑海内出现了一副奇异的画面。

那是一片苍茫的大地，他似站在了半空向下俯视，在他的目光里，大地上出现了密密麻麻近百万的人群，一眼看不到边际，仿若没有尽头一样。

“这是……哪里……”苏铭喃喃，这一幕，让他心神震撼，脑海中一片空白。

这些人群分成两个阵营，此刻全部跪在地上，向着天空膜拜，更有阵阵苍凉的鼓声回荡天地。形成了说不出的一股音浪，可触动灵魂一样，让一切听到者，都会心神一震。

半空中，苏铭的四周，他看到了有近百个巨大的蛮像，那一个个蛮像都各自不同，散发出原始野蛮的气息，身躯看起来似有血肉，如具备了生命。

他们此刻同样单膝跪下，向着天空膜拜！

苏铭下意识的抬起头，他看到了……

在那天空的至高之处，有两个顶天立地之人，那两个人看不清样子，但苏铭只是看了一眼，就有种如看见了天威一般的错觉，如自己成为了蝼蚁。

其中一人，苏铭只能看到那一头紫色的长发，此人右手抬起，向着天空蓦然一挥，立刻天地色变，转眼间朗朗乾坤瞬息成为了黑暗，无数星辰闪烁，在此人挥手间，那些星辰好似被牵引吸撤，竟从天空而来，转眼凝聚在那紫发之人身旁，赫然形成了一条星辰银河。

那银河被此人右手一指，发出轰隆滔天之音，直奔对面其敌而去，远远一看，这一幕如同天崩星河塌陷，似以整个天的力量降临在一个人身上。

轰鸣间，那紫衣男子忽然低头，其目光横扫，蓦然与苏铭竟有了对望！

苏铭脑海轰的一声，整个人好似被一股大力推动，直接从这看似虚幻的世界里被生生轰出。

苏铭身躯一颤，眼前一片漆黑，许久，许久，当他恢复了神智后，发现自己依旧还是在那蛮像的体内空间，四周没有幽光，仿佛一切都是他的错觉。

苏铭呼吸急促，全身被汗水淋湿，他猛的低头看向自己脖子上挂着的那碎片，这碎片黑黝黝的，除了有微弱的暖意外，没有丝毫不寻常的地方。

“是幻觉么……还是这蛮像的记忆……方才是……如兽皮革书描述，摘天之星辰么……”许久，苏铭才从之前的那一幕画面里完全清醒过来，目中有了迷茫，脑子里很乱，沉默了片刻后，起身再次向那蛮像躬身一拜，便准备离开这里。

只是，他这一拜才刚刚开始，立刻就有咔咔声从前方隐隐传出，只见那蛮像的脸部，出现了一道细微的裂缝，那裂缝随着苏铭的一拜的动作，还有蔓延的趋势。

似无法承受苏铭的一拜，若完整的参拜下去，仿佛这蛮像将会崩溃一样，这诡异的一幕，让苏铭倒吸口气，他脑中对于之前的一切，此刻再无丝毫怀疑，那绝不是错觉！

更是在那蛮像出现裂缝的一瞬间，似有阵阵喃喃之语在他脑海内回荡，那喃呢的声音，让苏铭眼中露出了狂喜之色，这声音，正是他梦寐以求的，修蛮者凝血境的修行之法！

修蛮之术，无法口口相传，唯一的方法就是蛮像传承，一个蛮像的存在，对于部落来说极为重要，这关系到其存亡延续。

当那喃呢的声音消失后，苏铭的身体也消失在了这蛮像体内的世界，出现在了乌山部落中，他刚一出现，立刻就看到四周包括阿公在内的所有族人，全部抬头看着天空，其内心一动，随之看去。

那巨大的漩涡还再旋转，闷闷的嗡鸣回荡。

“苏铭，到我身边来。”阿公的声音在苏铭耳边响起，苏铭内心忐忑，他隐隐觉得这天空的异常，应该是与自己脖子上的碎片有关，但此事却不敢说出，忐忑中走向阿公，站在其身后。

没过多久，那天空的异象渐渐散去，慢慢恢复如常，没有人去问苏铭是否参拜成功，毕竟没有光芒散出，则表示着失败。

直至天空恢复，余下的拉苏再次进行参拜，当全部结束时，此番蛮启，共有两个孩子被察出在十六岁时具备了蛮体。

这两个孩子被阿公带走，将会成为部落里的重要族人，传授一些蛮修的经验。

至于其他的拉苏，则是带着失落，各自散去，苏铭一路沉默，但内心却是怦怦跳动越加快速，他想要把这一切告诉给阿公，可是却隐隐觉得此事太大，尤其是蛮像竟出现了裂缝。

那穿着麻布长衫的阿公，在远处看了苏铭的背影一眼，露出了一丝疑惑。

匆匆回到了屋舍，苏铭坐在木床上，低头望着自己胸口的那黑色的样子不规则的碎片，双目露出迷茫，半响，他正要取下脖子上的挂件，但却犹豫了一下，起身推动木框挡在了屋门处，这样一来若有外人进来，他也可以有时间准备。

弄完这些，他这才重新坐下，把那石头碎片拿在手中，仔细的观察起来。

“这石头碎片到底是什么……它是小红找到的，估计是那天风太大了，把一些被腐叶吹起，使得此物露出，被小红捡到……”苏铭内心怦怦加速跳动，他隐隐觉得自己获得了一样未知的宝物。

“蛮像在它面前都要出现裂缝……不知道小红在什么位置捡的，还有没有了……”苏铭舔了舔嘴唇，双眼露出激动之意。

“我本来没有蛮体，无法得到修蛮的传承，但此物让我如今获得了修行之法！”苏铭深吸口气，压下激动，把全部精力都放在了这石头碎片上。

也不知过去了多久，他不觉中，有困意来袭，抓着那碎片，倒在了木床上，睡了过去。

那碎片此刻，渐渐散发出一闪一闪的幽光，很弱。
content_en:
At the foot of Wushan Mountain, in the Wushan tribe, almost all the tribesmen were at the center of the tribe at this moment, looking at the group of unruly Rasu.

But at this moment, the huge beast floating in the air suddenly shook, as if shaking, and a roaring sound suddenly sounded. The sound came so suddenly that all the tribesmen around were stunned.

Grandpa's eyes flashed, and he took a few steps forward. He did not look at the statue, but immediately raised his head to look at the sky. As he looked, his eyes showed solemnity.

At this moment, more tribesmen also noticed the abnormality and raised their heads to look at the sky.

I saw streaks of black energy appearing out of thin air in the sky, condensing crazily from all directions, and soon forming a huge vortex. The vortex was so big that it seemed to occupy most of the sky here, covering all directions of Wushan. Even from a long distance, you can still see the changes here.

After the vortex was formed, it slowly rotated and made a loud rumble like thunder, echoing around.In that vortex, there were countless arc-shaped electric lights swimming around, and lightning swept across, intertwining with thunder.

"The Barbarian Ancestor Appeared!?" The tribesmen in the Wushan Tribe, who knew who shouted it out, immediately knelt down and worshiped to the sky with expressions of awe and fear.

The only people standing were Grandpa and the leaders of several tribes beside him. In addition to Grandpa, these leaders also looked panicked.

The vortex in the sky rotated faster and faster. After a while, a strong wind seemed to sweep across the earth, completely covering all directions around Wushan Mountain.

The statue floating in mid-air was trembling even more violently at this moment, as if it could not bear the whirlpool.

At this moment, on the other side of Wushan, there is a tribe similar in size to the Wushan tribe. This tribe is called Heishan. Now, all the tribesmen in the Heishan tribe are shocked. In the mid-air of their tribe, a ten-foot-sized statue floats impressively.

The beast was completely black and had no human form at all. It looked like a lizard. It was trembling constantly as if it was about to collapse.Under the statue, there was an old man wearing a black linen gown, as skinny as a skeleton, with a gloomy expression, and he didn't know what he was thinking.

The same scene appeared at the same time in all the tribes near Wushan, and even in the tribes further away.

No one knows what happened and why this vortex appeared. Even the grandfather of the Wushan tribe ignored Su Ming, who had just entered the body of the elephant to worship.

In the Wushan tribe's statue, the dim light suddenly occupied all the surrounding space in a flash, filling the place with the strange light. Su Ming was stunned when he saw the statue not far away that had to be worshipped. It shook its whole body, as if it had been resurrected from a still sleep. It actually gave him the illusion that the statue had flesh and blood.

He could even see that the originally ferocious figure was trembling violently in the dim light, as if it could not withstand the light.

It looked like a half-man and half-animal, holding a giant dragon in his left hand and a spear in his right hand. But now, in that trembling state, the primitive and barbaric aura suddenly changed, revealing a hint of panic that made Su Ming wonder whether it was an illusion.

Su Ming's mind went blank. He didn't know what happened or why it happened. He stood there, stunned.

His whole body was also filled with the dim light of the neck fragment, and it seemed to be integrated with the space here. As the dim light became brighter and brighter, in just a moment, this strange world had completely turned into a dark color.

Su Ming only felt a bang in his head, as if some barrier was broken through by an invisible force. As his body trembled, a strange picture appeared in his mind.

It was a vast land. He seemed to be standing in mid-air and looking down. In his eyes, there were nearly a million people densely packed on the land. The edges could not be seen at a glance, as if there was no end.

"Where is this..." Su Ming murmured. This scene shocked him and his mind went blank.

These crowds were divided into two camps. At this moment, they were all kneeling on the ground, worshiping toward the sky, and bursts of desolate drums echoed around the world.It forms an indescribable wave of sound that can touch the soul and make everyone who hears it feel shocked.

In mid-air, around Su Ming, he saw nearly a hundred huge savage statues. Each of the savage statues were different from each other, exuding a primitive and savage aura. Their bodies seemed to have flesh and blood, as if they were alive.

At this moment, they also knelt down on one knee and worshiped toward the sky!

Su Ming subconsciously raised his head and saw...

At the highest point in the sky, there were two people standing tall and tall. The appearance of the two people could not be clearly seen, but Su Ming just glanced at them and felt as if he had seen the power of God, as if he had become an ant.

Among them, Su Ming could only see the long purple hair. The man raised his right hand and waved towards the sky. The color of the sky and the earth immediately changed. In the blink of an eye, the bright sky turned into darkness. Countless stars twinkled. As the man waved his hand, the stars seemed to be pulled away and came from the sky. In a blink of an eye, they gathered around the purple-haired man, forming a galaxy of stars.

The Milky Way was pointed by this person's right hand, making a roaring sound and heading straight towards the enemy on the opposite side. From a distance, this scene was like the sky collapsing and the galaxy collapsing, as if the whole power of the sky had descended on a person.

During the roar, the man in purple suddenly lowered his head, his eyes swept across, and he suddenly looked at Su Ming!

There was a bang in Su Ming's mind, and his whole body seemed to be pushed by a strong force, and he was directly blasted out of this seemingly illusory world.

Su Ming's body trembled, and his vision went dark. After a long, long time, when he regained his consciousness, he found that he was still in that pretty body space, with no dim light around him, as if everything was his illusion.

Su Ming's breathing was rapid, and his whole body was soaked with sweat. He lowered his head sharply and looked at the fragment hanging around his neck. The fragment was dark, and except for a faint warmth, there was nothing unusual about it.

"Is it an hallucination... or is it the memory of this resemblance... just like the description in the animal leather book, picking the stars from the sky..." It took a long time for Su Ming to fully wake up from the previous scene. His eyes were confused and his mind was confused. After a moment of silence, he stood up, bowed to the resemblance again, and was about to leave.

However, he had just begun to pray, and there was a faint clicking sound coming from the front immediately, and a slight crack appeared on the pretty face. The crack had a tendency to spread as Su Ming bowed.

It seemed that he could not bear Su Ming's worship. If he paid homage in full, it seemed that the statue would collapse. This strange scene made Su Ming take a breath. At this moment, he no longer had the slightest doubt about everything before. It was definitely not an illusion!

At the moment when cracks appeared in the savage statue, waves of murmuring words seemed to echo in his mind. The murmuring voice made Su Ming's eyes reveal a look of ecstasy. This voice was exactly what he had dreamed of, the cultivation method of the barbarian blood coagulation realm!

The art of cultivating barbarians cannot be passed down orally. The only way is to pass on the barbarian image. The existence of a barbarian image is extremely important to the tribe, which is related to its survival and continuation.

When the murmuring voice disappeared, Su Ming's body also disappeared into the world that looked like a human body, and appeared in the Wushan tribe. As soon as he appeared, he immediately saw all the tribesmen around him, including Grandpa, looking up at the sky. His heart moved and he looked up.

The huge whirlpool was spinning again, and a muffled buzz echoed.

"Su Ming, come to me." Grandpa's voice rang in Su Ming's ears. Su Ming felt uneasy in his heart. He vaguely felt that the abnormality in the sky was related to the fragment on his neck, but he did not dare to say anything about it. He walked towards Grandpa and stood behind him in anxiety.

Not long after, the strange phenomenon in the sky gradually dissipated and returned to normal. No one asked Su Ming whether his visit to the shrine was successful. After all, no light emitted, which meant failure.

Until the sky was restored, the remaining Lasu went to worship again. When it was all over, this time the barbarians started, and a total of two children were found to have barbarian bodies at the age of sixteen.

These two children were taken away by Grandpa and will become important members of the tribe and teach them some barbaric cultivating experiences.

As for the other Lasu, they dispersed with disappointment. Su Ming was silent all the way, but his heart was beating faster and faster. He wanted to tell his grandpa all this, but he felt that the matter was too big, especially since there were cracks in the image.

The grandfather, who was wearing a linen gown, glanced at Su Ming's back from a distance and showed a trace of doubt.

Hurrying back to the house, Su Ming sat on the wooden bed and looked down at the black irregular fragments on his chest. His eyes were confused. For a moment, he was about to take off the pendant around his neck, but hesitated. He stood up and pushed the wooden frame to block the door. This way, if an outsider came in, he would have time to prepare.

After doing this, he sat down again, took the stone fragments in his hands, and observed them carefully.

"What exactly is this stone fragment... It was found by Xiao Hong. It was probably because the wind was too strong that day and blew up some rotten leaves, exposing the stone fragment and being picked up by Xiao Hong..." Su Ming's heart was pounding faster, and he vaguely felt that he had obtained an unknown treasure.

"It seems like cracks are about to appear in front of it... I don't know where Xiao Hong picked it up and if there is any left..." Su Ming licked his lips, his eyes showing excitement.

"I originally didn't have a barbarian body and couldn't obtain the inheritance of barbarian cultivation, but this thing allows me to obtain the method of cultivation now!" Su Ming took a deep breath, suppressed his excitement, and put all his energy on the stone fragments.

He didn't know how much time had passed, but before he knew it, he felt sleepy. He grabbed the fragment, fell on the wooden bed, and fell asleep.

At this moment, the fragment gradually emitted a flickering light, which was very weak.
